text: Fiona Murray, Deputy City Clerk, Toronto Elections will give a presentation on the 2022 Election Accessibility Plan, providing an overview of initiatives aimed at improving accessibility for voters and candidates with disabilities during an election cycle.

The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee recommends that: 1. The Executive Committee direct the Deputy City Clerk, Toronto Election Services to report back to the June 13, 2022 Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee on how those who relied on at-home voting will be accommodated in the upcoming municipal election.
